name: Rhonda
source:
Believes herself to be a proper young lady, turning up her nose at anything that she deems unworthy of her. Usually gets upset if things don't go her way, but is willing to make compromises. Thinks she's smarter than Henry and interrupts all the time. Surprisingly the most honest of the three despite her blackmailing nature.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31385]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
